caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a woman, rendered in color. The woman has wavy brown hair and is shown from the waist up. She wears a red vest-like garment with visible shading and texture, fastened with a brown belt that has a gold buckle at the center. Under the vest, she has a blue collar and a light, long-sleeved shirt with voluminous sleeves; the collar appears to be painted in a darker tone compared to the shirt. Below her waist, the structure transitions into a draped cloth painted in tones of blue-grey, with a wooden post extending downward. Flanking the post are vertical green leaf motifs. Her cheeks show a slight blush and her lips are painted a natural color. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white, and there are no other objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Figurehead
